title: EndpointAcceptancePackContents
description: The artefact.contents of a RulePackStaged payload whose packType is exactly endpoint-acceptance (INV-REQ-589): the accepted specification versions with the dates they are accepted from and to. A version is accepted on a date D when accepted_from is on or before D and accepted_to is absent or on or after D; both ends are inclusive (Inference: the example of INV-AC-7967 gives no edge date). An absent accepted_to means the version is accepted with no end date (Inference: INV-REQ-589 names both dates and says nothing about an open end). Rules JSON Schema cannot express, checked by rules-svc at import, at the pack dry run and by the seed content test, not here: accepted_to is not before accepted_from; a pair (specVersion, accepted_from) appears once. A consumer ignores any property this schema does not name (API-41, FR-K.4); no object of this schema sets additionalProperties to false. Within a major version this schema is additive-only.

acceptances.description: The accepted specification versions with their dates.

specVersion.description: The specification version label (PINT-SG or SG Peppol BIS release).

accepted_from.description: The first date the version is accepted, inclusive.

accepted_to.description: The last date the version is accepted, inclusive; absent means no end date.
